newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa's Conscorp sees foreign listing soon.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa's Conscorp sees foreign listing soon.

text.p: South Africa's Conservation Corporation Africa (Conscorp) said on Sunday it planned to float stock on Nasdaq or the London stock exchange in the coming financial year.
In a statement, the eco-tourism venture also saw revenues jumping to $50 million in the current fiscal year from $30 million last year. The South African fiscal year ends February 28.
"Expected earnings, before interest and tax, for (this) year are $12 million for the current portfolio of lodges," it said.
Conscorp, formed in 1990, owns 21 game lodges in southern and East Africa and the statement said the company planned to expand into Latin America and Southeast Asia.

"(The company) plans to spend $12 million over the next six months on new projects, refurbishing of various existing lodges, development and acquisitions, which include that of a publishing company in Seattle and a documentary film production company in San Francisco," the statement said.
